visual_action: A static, satirical image designed to look like a conference speaker announcement. On a red background, the text 'CONFIRMED SPEAKER' appears above an image of a red, horned devil. A white box overlays the image with the text 'crazy pull for cpac 😭', 'THE DEVIL FROM THE BIBLE', and 'CONFIRMED FOR CPAC USA 2026'. A banner at the bottom reads 'Continue Reading on cpac.org/Blog'.

cast.name: CPAC
cast.evidence: The text 'cpac' and 'CPAC USA 2026' appears on screen.

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue. The audio consists of a loud, high-pitched, continuous scream.
audio_music: A loud, sustained, high-pitched scream plays throughout the video, creating a chaotic and alarming effect consistent with the satirical horror theme.
manipulation_or_satire: The image is a fabricated satirical poster. It superimposes an image of the Devil and fabricated text over a background to create a fake announcement that he will be a speaker at a CPAC conference, for the purpose of mockery.
central_claim: CPAC is so extreme that it would plausibly host the Devil as a speaker at its conference.
intended_effect: To mock CPAC and portray the organization and its speakers as evil.
